title: The Longhouse Grows
offer: With so many animals and friends, our house is too small! Bring twelve logs from Frosttorp, two crates of tools and two pots of tar, and we make it longer.

tar.name: Tar
tar.counted: {count|a pot of tar|{count} pots of tar}

steps.load_say: Twelve logs! Fill that big hold of yours.

steps.say: Axes and nails. Now the tar for the roof.
Hammering all night with the neighbours... Our longhouse is twice as long! Room for a feast.

fact: A longhouse could be made longer by adding a piece at the end, like a train.
